Messages.Author: David Edelstein
Messages.Body:
Can you play multiple damage prevention cards in response to one strike?
I.e., if someone inflicts 3 damage with one blow, could I play 3 Skin of
Rocks (or 1 Skin of Rock, 1 Unflinching Persistence, and 1
Indomitability, etc.) to negate all of it?

I suspect this is in a FAQ somewhere, but I couldn't find it.

-David

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
David Edelstein wrote:
>
> Can you play multiple damage prevention cards in response to one strike?
> I.e., if someone inflicts 3 damage with one blow, could I play 3 Skin of
> Rocks (or 1 Skin of Rock, 1 Unflinching Persistence, and 1
> Indomitability, etc.) to negate all of it?

Yes. The only restriction on damage prevention is that you can't play it
unless you have (preventable) damage left to prevent.
